atlas.cross_model_channels: coordinate alignment only, no semantic identity
atlas.failures: all failure/near-zero index rows retained; gallery failure panels clearly marked
atlas.maps: one signed RGB-sum map, linear symmetric own max scale with scale saved; no smoothing/clipping; positive/negative/mass derivatives labeled
atlas.near_zero: max abs<=1e-12 => zero display flag; retain numeric row
atlas.selection: all registered target summaries on all400 evaluation images; retain full raw atlas on first16 evaluation IDs in frozen order; fixed gallery first8; no hand-picked image claims

enhanced_methods.gradcam: descriptive, last-block norm1, class target only, token map explicitly labeled; no universal comparator requirement

blur.operator: torchvision.functional.gaussian_blur with explicit kernel/sigma; frozen clean blur once
blur.source: clean224crop RGB float32 in[0,1], then normalize per model

fidelity.deletion: replace selected cell RGB by same-location baseline b starting clean
fidelity.insertion: start b, restore same cells from clean
fidelity.normalized_auc: secondary only divide by F(x)-F(b); abs denominator<1e-6 -> NA, raw preserved
fidelity.ood_conditions: both zero and blur mandatory; no noise/inpainting replacement
fidelity.primary_ordinate: raw frozen class logit, trapezoid; insertion and deletion separate
fidelity.ranking: sum abs RGB coordinate attribution within cell; decreasing score then row-major cell ID
fidelity.select_count: floor(q*Ncells+0.5), include0 andall; x axis actual selected area/Ncells
fidelity.signed_positive_secondary: sum RGB then sum cell then max(score,0)

ig.near_zero_delta_rule: abs delta<1e-6 requires abs completeness residual<=1e-5
ig.rule: EP2 all64 calibration images and two frozen class targets; select smallest M whose relative L2 map difference to2M<=0.02 and normalized completeness residual<=0.01 on at least61/64 images per target and model; finite required on64/64; no pass -> EP2_NUMERICAL_CALIBRATION_FAILED, no new nodes
ig.selection: one fixed M per model shared all formal images; no per-image result-driven integration adaptation

runtime.load_io: load once; exclusive compute timing and end-to-end timing separately
regimes: batched VJP only if implemented and validated

stability.flip: horizontal flip in cropped RGB before normalization; exact inverse flip on maps; compare signed RGB-sum pixel Spearman and4x4 absolute-mass Spearman
stability.internal_flip: NOT_PLANNED due no fixed semantic correspondence

noise.reuse: same physical RGB perturbation across models

stability.round_trip: T_inverse(T(x)) equality is implementation check only
stability.strata_role: descriptive cumulative subsets, coverage reported, not confirmation
